summary: Iteration 4 — full review of the RECLAIM OS dashboard data-integrity overhaul (backend + frontend). Backend: new suite /app/backend/tests/test_dashboard_overhaul.py (41 tests) plus full regression run = 107 passed / 2 failed. VERIFIED: funnel is strictly monotonic (detected 228 → eligible 220 → evaluated 220 → policy_decided 220 → ready 170 → executed 170 → verifying 140 → recovered 14) and each /api/cases?stage=<s> count matches its funnel number exactly for all 8 stages plus at_risk/stopped/invalid/blocked; KPI money maps are per-currency dicts (INR/USD/EUR never summed) and net == gross − costs per currency; recovery rate == num/den with denominator == VERIFIED+NATURAL+NOT_RECOVERED only (STOPPED/INVALID excluded); cost-ledger totals == kpis.action_costs and count == executed_action_count (18), every entry has a human case_title, execution_mode SIMULATED, no _id, 401 without auth; charts: timeseries length == days for 7/30/90, per-currency keys only, failure_reasons humanized with raw code retained, sources limited to IMPORTED/SIMULATED taxonomy, cases_by_status sums to detected, attributed_action filter returns only VERIFIED_RECOVERED cases; policy_activity from audit trail (ALLOW 159 / APPROVAL 66 / BLOCK 9 / STOP 13, total 247); case list enrichment (title/why_at_risk/source_category), source + policy + status filters, all 4 sorts, search. Frontend (1920x1080 + 390x844, cookie session): funnel chips render monotonic values and every stage/side chip filters the table (stage-filter-chip) or navigates to /review; all KPI drill-downs work (at-risk → 163 rows, verified gross → 14 rows, verified-net → cost-ledger-modal with 18 rows + SIMULATED badges + close, exceptions → /review); KPI info-icon tooltips appear on hover with the exact formula; range 7D/30D/90D re-fetch and relabel; currency tabs strictly filter (INR ₹29,81,228 / USD $36,000 / EUR €24,000 at the same date — no cross-currency leakage); recovery-by-action bar click sets action-filter-chip (14 rows, all VERIFIED RECOVERED); status legend shows names+counts and filters; failure-reason axis shows 'Insufficient funds' etc. with 'raw code: insufficient_funds' in tooltip; no '50%' anywhere — 5 heuristic cases showed 'Heuristic assessment — no numeric confidence', LLM cases 'Model estimate 63/67/72% — uncalibrated', review queue shows LOW_CONFIDENCE_REVIEW text; case rows use 'Failed Payment for Order ORD-xxxx' as primary label with mono order/customer secondary; source-summary chips SIMULATED 68 / IMPORTED 160; empty state via source=LIVE plus working clear-all-filters; regression smoke passed (fresh CSV ingest → 16 rows/12 valid/4 exceptions/8 cases, scenario-btn-2 5-step SIMULATED result with open-case button, review approve click, decision replay). 2 REAL DEFECTS FOUND: (1) Policy Control Activity card body renders at 0x0 → visually EMPTY on desktop AND mobile even though the data is in the DOM; (2) status-legend chips are stretched to 173px-tall boxes and sit in the wrong grid cell (under the Recovery-by-Action chart, not the pie).

minor.issue: Legacy data not backfilled: 32 cases with model_version='heuristic-fallback-v1' still return confidence=0.5 and confidence_type=null. The UI hides it (it falls back to the model_version check) but the API still serves the fake 50% placeholder to any consumer. Fix: one-off migration $set confidence=null, confidence_type='heuristic' where model_version='heuristic-fallback-v1'.

63 LLM-analyzed cases have no confidence_type field, so CaseDetail renders 'Model estimate 68%' WITHOUT the required '— uncalibrated' suffix (verified on case_8cf5e6e98270). Backfill confidence_type='model_uncalibrated' for model_version=~/claude/.

Amount sorting compares raw numeric amount_at_risk across currencies (₹75,000 ranked against $450), i.e. it implicitly blends currencies for ordering — inconsistent with the per-currency-never-blended principle. Consider grouping/sorting within the selected currency or labelling the sort as 'raw amount, mixed currencies'.

Observation, not a bug: recovery_rate_pct is 100% (14/14) because no case has ever reached NOT_RECOVERED while 126 executed cases are still unresolved. The formula and the 'N of M' sub-line are honest, but a permanent 100% headline is easy to misread — consider also surfacing 'M unresolved / pending outcome' next to the rate.

ui_bugs.issue: HIGH: the card body measures 0x0 and is visually blank on desktop (1920) and mobile (390) — the ALLOW/APPROVAL/BLOCK/STOP counts, human approval line and block-rule list exist in the DOM but are never visible. Root cause: ChartCard wraps its children in recharts <ResponsiveContainer>, which is only valid for chart elements; the plain <div> policy content gets collapsed to zero size. Fix: give ChartCard a `raw`/`noChart` prop (or render the policy panel outside ResponsiveContainer) so non-chart content renders in a normal sized div. This directly fails the 'Policy Control Activity must not be empty' requirement.

MEDIUM: the legend is a separate grid item (className 'lg:col-span-1 -mt-4') so its chips are stretched by grid/flex alignment to ~173px tall empty boxes and appear under the 'Verified Recovery by Action' chart instead of under the Cases-by-Status pie. Chips still work when clicked, but the block looks broken. Fix: move the legend inside the Cases by Status ChartCard (below the chart) and add items-start/self-start.

issues: Policy Control Activity card is a large blank white area (see ui_bugs #1).
Cases-by-Status legend chips render as oversized empty-looking boxes in the wrong column (see ui_bugs #2).
Cosmetic (carry-over): recharts logs 'width(-1)/height(-1)' warnings on first mobile layout pass; charts render fine afterwards.

action_items: Fix Policy Control Activity rendering: do not wrap non-chart JSX in recharts ResponsiveContainer inside ChartCard (currently 0x0 / invisible).
Move the Cases-by-Status legend into the pie card and stop the chips from being stretched to 173px boxes.

Backfill legacy analysis fields: confidence=null/confidence_type='heuristic' for heuristic-fallback-v1 (32 cases) and confidence_type='model_uncalibrated' for claude cases (63 cases) so the API and the 'uncalibrated' label are honest everywhere.
Decide on amount sorting semantics across currencies (currently mixes ₹/$/€ in one numeric ordering).
Optional: show pending/unresolved outcome count next to the 100% recovery rate.
critical_code_review_comments: Dashboard.jsx ChartCard always wraps children in ResponsiveContainer — that is the root cause of the invisible Policy Control Activity panel; add a branch for non-chart children.

metrics.compute_funnel is correct and provably monotonic (later-stage sets are unioned into earlier ones) and execution evidence is taken from the audit trail — API stage counts matched funnel counts exactly for all 8 stages.

routes_cases.list_cases recomputes the whole funnel (3 full collection scans) on every stage-filtered request; fine at 228 cases but it will not scale — cache the funnel sets or push stage membership onto the case document.

Case source filtering (source_category) is applied in Python AFTER the Mongo query and after the 5000-doc fetch, then limit is applied — with larger datasets a source filter can silently truncate results; move source_category onto the document and filter in the query.
intelligence.py new code path is correct (confidence=None + confidence_type='heuristic'); only historical records are stale — needs a migration, not a code change.
Dashboard.jsx is 527 lines and mixes KPIs, 5 charts, table and modal; splitting the funnel/charts/table/ledger into components would keep it maintainable.

success_rate.backend: 95% (107/109 pytest; 2 failures are legacy-data confidence backfill)

rca_of_the_issue: Policy Control Activity: Dashboard.jsx's ChartCard unconditionally renders {children} inside recharts <ResponsiveContainer>. ResponsiveContainer expects a single chart element and clones it with computed width/height props; a plain <div> ignores those props and ends up collapsed to 0x0, so the DOM contains the counts (verified via innerText) while nothing is painted. status-legend: it is rendered as a sibling grid item of the chart cards with 'lg:col-span-1 -mt-4', so grid stretch alignment inflates each chip to the row height (173px) and places the block in the left column under the bar chart instead of under the pie. Legacy confidence values: intelligence.py now writes confidence=None/confidence_type, but the 95 pre-existing case documents were never migrated, so the API still returns the 0.5 placeholder and omits confidence_type.
